I was very impressed with this product- first, the dispenser pump sprays a fine mist, as opposed to other detanglers, which seem to have concentrated "blast" sprays.  It gave better coverage, and I felt I used less product to get the job done.  Second, it smelled good, and then most importantly, my daughter hardly put up a fuss about getting her hair combed.  She knows this as her "new tangle spray&

This product is amazing. Two quick sprays and my daughters hair can be brushed. This with a wet brush saves lives.

reviews.t: It smells fantastic and so much more natural than the other stuff ...
reviews.x: Just tried this earlier today on my daughter's nest of tangles.  It smells fantastic and so much more natural than the other stuff we were using before.  I'd be lying if I said I didn't get a single "ouch" out of her, but I got a lot less whining than what I usually experience when I try to get the tangles out of her hair!

My daughter has been begging for this, and I finally broke down.  I'm sorry I waited so long.  These products are amazing.  They smell great, and I love that there is nothing bad in them.  My biggest challenge now is finding enough space in the shower for all of them.

reviews.x: This is an awful product, unfortunately. After I applied it to my daughter's hair, a few different times, I noticed it left this weird film on her hair, and my hands were very sticky after styling her hair. I have tried numerous detangler products for her hair, and this was the worst by far. (I dumped it down the drain. )
It Does detangle the hair but leaves a really sticky residue.

With the five year old it has been a real struggle to get her hair brushed, and the two year old does what her sister does, mostly.  I bought the shampoo and the spray both and with the five year old it's no longer a struggle.  She's able to get the brush through her hair herself and let's me finish it up, smiles all around. Our daughter adores the smell and the fact that it eliminates the knots in her hair, leaving us free to brush it easily. The stickiness is not an issue when using this spray on wet hair. We will definitely continue using this detangler exclusively instead of some chemical filled product.  Works great on our daughter's hair, but definitely is stickier than the chemical-filled detanglers. We use it on dry hair,

I LOVE this detangler! It smells sooo good and the ingredients are all natural and great.  I have been trying to be very cautious about the products I buy for my children, especially the shampoos/conditioners/detanglers. reviews.t: You and the kids will love it!
reviews.x: We have 8 grandchildren. They all like to come to Grandma's house for dinner, stories and a bath. Now, bath time is even better with the Fresh Monster array of bath and shower products. We love them because they are "all natural" and work beautifully. The grandchildren (ages 18 months to 12 years)  love them because they relate positively to the fun packaging, they don't burn the eyes and leave them smelling a lot better than when they arrived (we like that too). Well worth it!

From this brand all of the products have fallen short, however, this by far is the worst. I can't spray it without my son gagging and sneezing (ok in all fairness it doesn't smell good at all). It's extremely drying (which sucks for a leave in of all things!) and doesn't come close to putting a dent in my daughters thick wavy hair- I struggle to comb thru it... I was hoping to love this and save some money. Doesn't look like that will be happening!

reviews.t: Great Detangler for kids and smells great
reviews.x: Love the scent and it works great getting out tangles. A little trick to make these last longer is to add a little filtered water. When we get about 1/3 of the way into bottle I refill to the top with purified water (to prevent bacterial growth) and it works the same as before it was diluted. We like the scent and will purchase again. I wish I could say the same about the shampoo and conditioner. I wrote a separate review on those.

Smells really nice. The smell doesn't stay on your hair, but I almost wish it did! It's very effective as a detangler. I only use "natural" hair products and after shampooing and conditioning, my hair is left feeling like straw and completely un-brush-able. A few sprays of the detangler make the brush slide easily through my hair. Highly recommend.

LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the Fresh Monster line!  My daughter has long very curly hair with a sensitive head.  This product is a MUST!  It really reduces the tangles and leaves her hair soft and shiny all day long.  I have also tried the Shampoo / Conditioner combo.  I love that the product is toxin free and I feel good about using it on my little one.

reviews.t: No more combing battles with Fresh Monster
reviews.x: My kids love Fresh Monster! Instead of battling with a comb after bath time, we just spray a little in their hair and it makes things so much easier. It smells really good, and is super effective. As a bonus, my kids love the monster picture on the bottle. I would highly recommend this product.

reviews.t: I really wanted to like this product
reviews.x: I really wanted to like this product, but it makes my children have sticky hair. I have stopped using it with at least 2/3 of the bottle left. Very disappointed. I hate to say it, but I will likely end up throwing it away.

Bought this for my niece who has tangles like I've never seen.  The product smells amazing and works great! And it's so nice to feel good about the products I give to the kids in my family.  I'm all for toxin free!

reviews.t: Would work but not for thin hair
reviews.x: I purchased this for my little one because he gets terribly tangled hair. My issue is that it leaves his very thin hair matted and oily looking. I do love the scent and ingredients.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant scent, with many saying it smells great or fantastic.
Many reviewers report that it effectively detangles hair and reduces brushing struggles and tears.
Several reviewers value the natural, child-safe ingredients.
Some reviewers complain about a sticky or greasy residue left on hair and hands.
A few reviewers report quality or durability problems, such as a broken sprayer or defective pieces and poor seller response.
